core_obligations: For U ∈ B compute H_n^m(U): vanishing for m ≠ 0 and H_n^0(U) = F_n(U) by assumption (2) (proof lines 9569-9573).

From the short exact sequence (equation-ses-Rlim-over-U) and assumption (3) get H^m(U) = 0 for m ≠ 0 and lim F_n(U) for m = 0; sheafify using assumption (1) to conclude K = R lim F_n equals lim F_n (proof lines 9574-9581).
Second assertion: H^p(U', lim F_n) = 0 for p > 0 and all opens U' (proof lines 9581-9582).
proof_roadmap: Evaluate the derived-limit discussion on basis opens.
Sheafify over the basis and conclude both assertions.
difficulty_reason: The proof uses the per-open bookkeeping of the derived-limit discussion: assumption (2) kills the higher H_n^m, the short exact sequence for R lim over U together with assumption (3) computes the limit terms, and sheafification over the basis B finishes.
